info.title: Spaghetti API
info.summary: A private 3D printing notebook for two people, and what agents can do in it.
info.description: Made from the code, never written by hand. Auth is a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer spg_…`) for agents or the session cookie for people; a token only sees what its scopes allow. Times are epoch milliseconds, ids are UUIDs the client picks, and every write is safe to retry. See docs/api.md.

get.summary: What worked before for this build and material: attempts and recipes.
get.description: Needs the "read" scope. A route may narrow this by what the body asks for; see docs/api.md.

400.description: invalid: the request couldn't be read; the message says what is wrong.

401.description: signed_out or invalid_token: no credentials, or a token that is unknown or revoked.

403.description: missing_scope or person_only: the token lacks the scope, or only a signed-in person may.

post.summary: A change on the feed, POSTed to a webhook.
post.description: One change per request, in the shape of `GET /api/changes`. Check the signature before trusting it (docs/api.md, Webhooks); answer 2xx quickly, anything else is retried for a day.

parameters.name: Spaghetti-Timestamp
parameters.description: Seconds since the epoch when it was sent.

parameters.name: Spaghetti-Signature
parameters.description: `v1=` and the hex HMAC-SHA256, with the webhook's secret, of `<timestamp>.<body>`.

parameters.name: Spaghetti-Delivery
parameters.description: The delivery's id, the same across retries.

bearerAuth.description: An agent's token, `spg_…`; made on the Agents page.

connection.description: Set for an app connected by OAuth (its short-lived tokens are not listed).

Agent.description: Tokens are listed only for their owner.

prefix.description: The start of the token, for telling tokens apart.

outcome.description: Null while it is still printing.

endedAt.description: When the printer bridge saw the print stop.

photoRead.description: What Claude made of the attempt's photo; only ever a suggestion.

coach.description: What Claude suggests trying next after a Partly or Spaghetti answer; only ever suggestions.

changes.description: What changed since the attempt before it.

createdVia.description: The agent it was logged through.

seq.description: Position in the feed: the cursor.

id.description: The thing's id (a slot's name, "x2d" for the printer, "<kind>:<slug>" for a tag).

itemId.description: The idea or build it belongs to.

more.description: Ask again with the new cursor.

reset.description: The cursor couldn't be followed: treat everything as changed.

seq.description: The change's cursor; null for a test event.

code.description: Stable, for code to branch on.

createdVia.description: The agent it was captured through.

draft.description: Claude's draft from a model page, while there is one.

reactions.description: Who reacted, and how, oldest first.

files.description: Slicer files kept with the idea (and its build), oldest first.

Item.description: An idea, or a build (an idea that is being printed).

token.description: Shown once; only a hash is kept.

photoUrl.description: Their picture, versioned, or null for initials.

Reaction.description: One person's reaction to an idea, build or comment.

remaining.description: The level: derived from the grams when there are gram data.

productCode.description: Bambu's RFID or product code, when a label printed one.

fromLabel.description: The fields Claude filled in from a label photo that nobody has edited since.

labelRead.description: A label read going on, waiting for a tap, or that found nothing; null otherwise.

deliveryId.description: The same across retries: dedupe on it.

WebhookPayload.description: What a webhook receives: the change feed's own shape, one change at a time.

private.description: Kept to themselves; someone else's private list comes with no entries.
